summary: Hamas's Rafah Brigade commander Samir Abu Younis was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis, marking the third brigade commander eliminated since May. The IDF destroyed a 35-meter underground tunnel with living quarters in Majdal Zoun, South Lebanon, while continuing ceasefire enforcement operations. Houthi forces claimed a ballistic missile attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, escalating regional tensions.
key_points: Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Samir Abu Younis killed in Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis, third commander eliminated since May 2025. (Source: @manniefabian/59518)
IDF destroyed 35-meter underground tunnel with two living rooms in Majdal Zoun, South Lebanon, by Brigade 300 and Yahalom unit. (Source: @yediotnews25/137853)
Houthis claim ballistic missile attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. (Source: @N12chat/235205)
Explosions and SAM launches reported in Qeshm Island and Strait of Hormuz, Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12403, @shin_persian/12416, @shin_persian/12401)
US Ambassador to UN Mike Waltz arrived in Beirut to discuss UNIFIL alternatives as mandate expires in a month. (Source: @yediotnews25/137856)
US intelligence estimates Iran retains 1,500-2,500 ballistic missiles despite facility damage. (Source: @yediotnews25/137855)
Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian olive harvesters near Sa'ir, West Bank, injuring at least five; IDF condemned attackers. (Source: @manniefabian/59519)
Mossad chief Roman Gofman briefed US officials and CIA on Iran intelligence, will update Israeli cabinet and PM Netanyahu. (Source: @yediotnews25/137857)

sections.executive_summary: Hamas's Rafah Brigade commander Samir Abu Younis was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis, marking the third brigade commander eliminated since May. The IDF destroyed a 35-meter underground tunnel with living quarters in Majdal Zoun, South Lebanon, while continuing ceasefire enforcement operations. Houthi forces claimed a ballistic missile attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, escalating regional tensions.

points: Multiple explosions and surface-to-air missile launches were reported from Qeshm Island in Hormozgan Province and the Strait of Hormuz, indicating active air defense engagement. (Source: @shin_persian/12403, @shin_persian/12416, @shin_persian/12401, @shin_persian/12402)
US intelligence estimates Iran retains between 1,500 and 2,500 ballistic missiles despite recent strikes on its missile production facilities. (Source: @yediotnews25/137855)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad-Baqer Qalibaf stated Tehran will not accept a prolonged state of neither war nor peace with the United States and called on the US to agree to Iran's 7-point plan. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10061)
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi was tracked aboard a government aircraft (EP-IGF, callsign IRAN05) descending toward Islamabad, Pakistan, for diplomatic talks. (Source: @shin_persian/12415)

Mossad chief Roman Gofman returned from a special visit to the US where he updated senior American officials and the CIA director on the latest intelligence regarding Iran, and is scheduled to brief the security cabinet and Prime Minister Netanyahu. (Source: @yediotnews25/137857)

IDF forces from Brigade 300 under Division 91, together with the Yahalom engineering unit, destroyed a 35-meter underground tunnel route with two living rooms in the village of Majdal Zoun in southern Lebanon. (Source: @yediotnews25/137853)

Israeli warplanes were tracked over the Beqaa Valley and Baalbek-Hermel regions in eastern Lebanon, and flares were dropped over the town of Zibqin al-Sharqiyah in the south. (Source: @redlinkleb/53329, @redlinkleb/53328, @redlinkleb/53395)
President Isaac Herzog told a visiting UN ambassador delegation that the Iranian issue hovers over Israel and threatens the entire region. (Source: @N12chat/235209)

Hamas confirmed the killing of Samir Abu Younis (Abu Mahmoud), commander of the Rafah Brigade, in an Israeli airstrike in the Khan Younis area; he was a veteran Al-Qassam commander since 1991 and involved in planning the October 7 attack. (Source: @manniefabian/59518)

The IDF struck a senior Hamas military wing commander in the Khan Younis area overnight, and on Thursday struck the Nasser Hospital complex targeting the Khan Younis Brigade commander. (Source: @manniefabian/59520, @manniefabian/59518)

Dozens of masked Israeli settlers from an illegal outpost attacked Palestinians harvesting olives near the village of Sa'ir in the southern West Bank, injuring at least five; the IDF condemned the attackers and imposed a closed military zone. (Source: @manniefabian/59519)

Hamas has appointed a third Rafah Brigade commander during the war after the previous two, Muhammad Shabana (killed May 13, 2025) and Nael Abu Obeid (killed September), were eliminated by Israel. (Source: @manniefabian/59518)

IDF Brigade 300 and Yahalom destroyed a 35-meter underground tunnel with two living rooms in Majdal Zoun, continuing operations in the security zone per the ceasefire agreement. (Source: @yediotnews25/137853)

Israeli warplanes conducted flights over the Beqaa Valley and Baalbek-Hermel, and dropped illumination flares over Zibqin al-Sharqiyah in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/53329, @redlinkleb/53328, @redlinkleb/53395)
Artillery shelling was reported in Wadi al-Hujeir in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/53394)

US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz arrived in Beirut to discuss alternatives to UNIFIL, whose mandate expires in about a month, and to express US support for a sovereign Lebanon free from Hezbollah and Iranian influence. (Source: @yediotnews25/137856)
A large explosion was reported in the Al-Musayyib District of Babil Province, Iraq. (Source: @shin_persian/12410)
Israeli warplanes were tracked over the Beqaa Valley, which borders Syria, but no specific Syrian targets were mentioned in the sources. (Source: @redlinkleb/53329)
Houthi forces claimed responsibility for a ballistic missile attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. (Source: @N12chat/235205)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Qalibaf warned Tehran will not accept a prolonged neither-war-nor-peace situation with the US and demanded US agreement to Iran's 7-point plan. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10061)
Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi traveled to Pakistan, a Gulf-adjacent state, for diplomatic engagement. (Source: @shin_persian/12415)

sections.threat_assessment: The elimination of Hamas's third Rafah Brigade commander in five months demonstrates Israel's sustained targeting of Hamas's command structure in Gaza, even as the group regenerates leadership. Simultaneous Israeli air activity over eastern Lebanon and tunnel destruction in the south indicate continued enforcement of the ceasefire terms while maintaining pressure on Hezbollah infrastructure. The Houthi ballistic missile strike on Riyadh marks a significant escalation in Red Sea theater, potentially testing Saudi air defenses and US security commitments. Unexplained explosions and SAM launches in the Strait of Hormuz suggest either Iranian air defense drills or responses to unidentified aerial activity, raising risks of miscalculation in the strategic waterway.
sections.regional_response: The US is actively shaping the post-UNIFIL security architecture in Lebanon through Ambassador Waltz's Beirut visit, signaling a push for a Hezbollah-free Lebanese security sector. Iran's diplomatic outreach to Pakistan via Foreign Minister Araghchi and Qalibaf's public ultimatum to the US reflect a dual-track strategy of regional coalition-building and direct confrontation signaling. Saudi Arabia faces a direct Houthi missile threat to its capital, likely prompting enhanced bilateral defense coordination with Washington. Israel's domestic political turbulence, including allegations of election interference, may constrain wartime decision-making but has not visibly degraded operational tempo across multiple fronts.
sections.intelligence_notes: The precision of the Khan Younis strike suggests high-fidelity intelligence on Hamas's rotating command cadre, possibly enabled by persistent surveillance and human networks in the area. The 35-meter tunnel in Majdal Zoun with dedicated living quarters indicates Hezbollah's investment in sustained subterranean presence near the border, despite the ceasefire. The clustering of Iranian air defense activity around Qeshm Island — a strategic choke point in the Strait of Hormuz — warrants monitoring for deployment of advanced systems or rehearsal of denial operations. The Mossad chief's Washington visit and imminent cabinet briefing imply imminent policy decisions on Iran, potentially including kinetic options given the missile inventory assessment.
